meta.title: Demotion gate - a live strategy goes back to paper
meta.status: PROPOSED (not yet enforced in code; no strategy is live today, so nothing is being demoted)
meta.author: arena/4a709dd0-korea2
meta.relation_to_existing_work: quant-lab/leaderboard.html states a one-line demotion rule ('a qualified strategy that turns negative over its next 100 settled bets drops back to paper'). This specification generalises that rule, adds measurable triggers, an evaluation cadence, hysteresis and re-promotion criteria. Where the two differ, this spec is the proposal and the quant-lab sentence is the earlier sketch.
principles: Demotion is triggered by signal decay or process failure, never by staking outcomes (staking losses alone do not demote if the signal block is healthy - see price-desk leaderboard split).
Every trigger has a stated sample-size floor so noise cannot demote a healthy strategy.
Demotion stops staking immediately but keeps logging signals, so evidence can accumulate for re-promotion.
The gate is symmetric: the same metrics that promote a strategy demote it.

triggers.name: Signal ROI decay
triggers.definition: Flat-stake ROI at closing prices over the trailing 100 settled bets (minimum 100) is <= 0 AND the permutation p-value for that window is > 0.10 (no evidence the edge is distinguishable from luck).
triggers.rationale: 100 flat-stake bets is the same evaluation length as the earlier quant-lab rule; the permutation test prevents demoting on a coin-flip window. Sources: flat-stake framing and permutation control already published in origination/site_data/leaderboard.csv; statistical caution per NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook (https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/).

triggers.name: Closing-line value reversal
triggers.definition: Mean CLV (our number vs the market close, in points or probability per market type) over the trailing 8 settled weeks is strictly negative.
triggers.rationale: CLV is the price-skill metric the competition design already ranks on (data/leaderboard.json LB-02); a persistent negative CLV means the strategy is paying the worst of the number even before outcomes.

triggers.name: Drawdown breach
triggers.definition: The declared staking plan's bankroll curve falls more than 25% below its running peak at any close of business week.
triggers.rationale: Bankroll survival rule; protects the pool from ruin while the signal block is being re-evaluated. Drawdown is a staking-layer metric, so it can demote STAKING without demoting SIGNAL (the signal block keeps logging).

triggers.name: Process violation
triggers.definition: Any settled bet whose ticket was logged after its event started, whose price could not be recorded at placement, whose stake exceeded the declared cap, or whose market data row fails verification (unverified value used as if verified).
triggers.rationale: Integrity gates (the CTRL_LEAK demonstration in origination/site_data/leaderboard.csv shows what happens without them). One confirmed violation demotes immediately; there is no sample floor.

triggers.name: Input-data withdrawal
triggers.definition: An input the strategy depends on becomes unverified, stale beyond its refresh cadence, or is retracted (e.g., an archive disagreement with an official source).
triggers.rationale: A strategy evaluated on data that later fails verification cannot keep a live label. Ties the demotion gate to the results-feed verification status fields.

evaluation_cadence: Every Monday 12:00 UTC during the season on settled bets as of the preceding Sunday night; triggers DG-T3/T4/T5 evaluate continuously.

on_demotion: Strategy state moves LIVE -> PAPER. Stake size becomes 0 immediately (signals keep being produced and logged).
The strategy's page carries a DEMOTED chip with the trigger id and window that fired.
Rewards accrual stops at the demotion timestamp (no retroactive clawback of virtual points already banked).

re_promotion.rule: A demoted strategy returns to LIVE only after a fresh paper window of 100 settled flat-stake bets in which flat-stake ROI > 0 AND permutation p <= 0.10 AND mean CLV >= 0, with no process violation in the window.
re_promotion.limits: At most one re-promotion per strategy per season; a second demotion in the same season is terminal for that season (strategy returns to research status).

open_parameters_for_owner_decision: Trailing window length (100 bets proposed; 50 and 150 are reasonable alternatives - trade-off table on the suggestions page, S-07).
Whether re-promotion is allowed at all.
